events.title: Philadelphia Chinese Lantern Festival
events.excerpt:
The Philadelphia Chinese Lantern Festival illuminates Franklin Square with awe-inspiring, interactive, larger-than-life lanterns!
The iconic 200-foot-dragon will soar back to Franklin Square for the summer along with never-before-seen giant lantern displays, more lights, more lanterns, and more wattage than ever before!
Enjoy live performances, delicious food and drink, the Franklin Square Fountain Show, and Franklin Square attractions.
Tickets will be available April 6 at phillychineselanternfestival.org
